```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(tidyverse)
library(ranger)

met_outcomes <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_outcomes.RData")
met_data <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/met_cohort_data.RData")


geneoutcome <- full_join(met_data, met_outcomes)

```

#Met pro RFE feature selection
```{r}
pro_data <- geneoutcome[, !(names(geneoutcome) %in% "Sample")] %>%
  filter(Cohort == "Met_Exp") %>%
  filter(Reason.for.discontinuation == "Progression" | Reason.for.discontinuation == "Therapy complete") %>%
  select(-Cohort)

#separating predictors from  Reason.for.discontinuation
x_vars_pro <- pro_data[, !(names(pro_data) %in% "Reason.for.discontinuation")]
y_var_pro <- pro_data$Reason.for.discontinuation
y_var_pro <- as.factor(y_var_pro)

#define the control using random forest functions
control <- rfeControl(
  functions = rfFuncs,  
  method = "cv",      
  number = 5     
)

#run the RFE algorithm
set.seed(43201)     
rfe_results_pro <- rfe(
  x = x_vars_pro,
  y = y_var_pro,
  sizes = c(1:79),     
  rfeControl = control
)

#print summary of the feature selection process
print(rfe_results_pro)

#plot performance vs. number of features
ggplot(rfe_results_pro, output = "ggplot") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18))

ggsave("../figures/rf_metapro_greedygraph.png", width = 7, height = 7)

#extract the top 2 features directly without updating the model object
features_size_2 <- rfe_results_pro$control$functions$selectVar(rfe_results_pro$variables, 2)
print(features_size_2)
```

#Met exhaustive pro
```{r}
pro_geneoutcome <- geneoutcome %>%
    filter(Cohort == "Met_Exp") %>%
    filter(Reason.for.discontinuation == "Therapy complete" | Reason.for.discontinuation == "Progression")

#define factors and target variable name
pro_factors <- c("BCL6", "SPN", "CD127", "TNF", "PTPRC_1", "RORC", "CDKN2A (p16)", "CD4", "PTPRC_3", "CD27")
target_col <- "Reason.for.discontinuation"
pro_target <- as.factor(pro_geneoutcome[[target_col]])

#generate all possible non-empty combinations of the 10 factors
allpro_subsets <- unlist(lapply(1:length(pro_factors), function(k) {
  combn(pro_factors, k, simplify = FALSE) }), recursive = FALSE)

#make data frame to store results
pro_results <- data.frame(
  Model_ID = seq_along(allpro_subsets),
  Features = sapply(allpro_subsets, paste, collapse = " + "),
  Num_Features = sapply(allpro_subsets, length),
  Performance = NA_real_
)

set.seed(43201)
for (i in seq_along(allpro_subsets)) {
  current_vars <- allpro_subsets[[i]]
  formula_str <- paste(target_col, "~", paste(current_vars, collapse = " + "))
  
  fit <- ranger(
    x = pro_geneoutcome[, current_vars, drop = FALSE], 
    y = pro_target,   
    num.trees = 100,     
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  #store the OOB error 
  pro_results$Performance[i] <- fit$prediction.error
}

#view the top 20 best-performing models (lowest error)
best_models <- pro_results %>% arrange(Performance)
head(best_models, 20)
```
